note:
c05 Vivaldi, Handel, J. S. Bach, Biber: all four covered completely, with the gap check. Scoring from IMSLP (api.php wikitext); floor and most durations from the Apple Music catalogue (iTunes Search API, song search by catalogue number; minutes = median over the albums with the modal number of tracks) and track lookups of complete Biber cycles; work lists from Wikipedia (Vivaldi after Ryom, Handel HWV, Bach chamber list, Biber article).
Judgment calls for the owner:
(1) Vivaldi's chamber concertos RV 87-108 are kept: one player to a part, no ripieno (IMSLP flags them concerto?).
(2) Bach's Brandenburg No. 6 is kept (six solo parts, no ripieno; violone folded into the continuo). Not added: No. 5 (out-of-scope page, 'orchestra'), whose ripieno is one violin, viola, cello and violone and which is often played one to a part; No. 3 has ten parts.
